name: A Friend
comment: Look at what I have to say!

name: Third Parent
comment: This blog is the coolest thing I have ever read.

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: I cant wait to see the underwater videos!

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: I could have danced with all the Gogos all day

name: Gogo
comment: Wow! Aunt Mary has really been busy!  Aunt Olivia and I will be so excited to get our new clothes.

name: Gogo
comment: Hello Mtemba - I am so excited to be able to talk to you about your fantastic Malawi Adventures blog!  I miss you guys, and hearing from you about your week helps me get through the days!

name: Gogo
comment: Your new outfit matching Mom and Dad look great!

name: Gogo
comment: It was very sweet of you to surprise Mom and Amayi with Mother's Day cards.  I know it made them feel special.

name: Joy
comment: Hey everyone!  Love the addition of the comments section!  Mtemba, stop getting so tall!!!  The picture of you and Chiboda standing next to the statue compared to the current one shows how much you have grown!  Speaking of, where is Chiboda?  I don't see any recent pics of him.  I bet he has grown, too.  I hope to see you when you come back to the USA!  Love you, stay safe.

name: Gogo
comment: Wow Mtemba, that sounds like a fun time with Mom's friends!  So many things everyone got to see and do and I don't think that is the whole trip, lol.  I'm glad you got to spend some time with Janet's son, Shama.  It sounds like it made the drive more fun.

name: Rando
comment: I love your wings!

name: Gogo
comment: Amayi!  I love your new sewing machine!  I can't wait to see all the things you make :)  Is that a scone picnic on the Conde?  Love their scones!  Sharon makes a great model for Mary's sewing.  She is so pretty.  Mtemba you have always had a great imagination and I am so glad you are having some down time to really explore, create and grow!  Alexandra, I am excited to see all the things you guys come up with for market.  Love the books.  A new Chambo man?  what happened to the other guy?  Miss you guys.

name: Emmanuel Mwandama
comment: This was so sweet. Thank you Matemba and your Mom for visiting my Village. You left great memories. You inspired the kids who enjoyed your English. Please invite more of your friends to be coming to Malawi

name: Emmanuel Mwandama
comment:
Hi Alexandra,

I love what you guys did on this day. My eyes are always filled with tears of Joy when I receive calls from the village all thanking you for what you did, the impact was too much. Imagine a 80 year old saying “In my entire life I have never received a Blanket, shake Azungu hands, slept on a Mattress,   All this was happened because Alinafe Global Outreach came.

Your visit to Amayi’s Church was life Changing. The Church now is receiving visitors every sunday and the Church is growing. 

Thank you on behalf of my people. Those who want to connect with us reach out through our website www.alinafeglobaloutreach.org

name: Kris Kennet
comment: I'm so amazed and grateful to God for helping these beautiful people. Seeing joy on the faces and hearing it in their songs.

name: Kathy Peterson
comment:
Thank you for the food descriptions, love to hear about the meals you have in Malawi. 
The pool in Eden looks like so much fun! I teach swimming lessons & like to check out pools. 
Keep writing!

name: Janet Nkhalamba
comment: I love seeing the impact you people are making in our community. This is what we call preaching love in action. May God keep blessing the works of your hands and perfect all that concerns you. Someone's life has changed for good becouse of your visitation. My prayer is Alinafe Global Outreach will achieve more than what is in the vision, so help us God.

name: A friend
comment: I LOVE the idea of Walrus the Penguin! Can we get the link to his blog? My kids would love to see where Walrus has been.

name: Gogo
comment: Wow!  What a cool caterpillar, Mtemba.  Thanks for sharing it.  I'm glad you didn't eat it :)  It's good to see Chiboda!  Love the pictures of the twins and Amayi!  Miss you guys.

name: Gram
comment:
Your penpal project sounds very interesting!
Also, please don’t bring any of those caterpillars home!

name: Joy
comment: Hey there!  I'm sorry I haven't written to you more.  I will try to be a better Aunt!  Aggie baseball, huh?  If I was there,  I would listen with you.  I love baseball.  Someday I hope for you to meet my son Adam.  He played baseball from the age of 5 to 17!  He played first base and he is very smart like you!  I talk about you to him all the time.  My friend Joe is a pastor and he and some of his congregation are on a mission trip to Zambia.  Are you familiar with that country? I'm not sure where that is in relation to Malawi. Stephanie, London's mom, is living with us now and she has started a garden with tomatoes, zucchini, okra and many other foods.  She found a caterpillar eating on her tomato plant!  She had a fit!!    Bright and Star are adorable!  Well its time for my lunch, so I will write more later.  Tell Mom, Dad and Chiboda hello from me!

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: Another baby bird! You're a bird magnet, word has gotten out to all the birds that you're a good babysitter! That petrol station has an inflatable man, but it looks like no petrol? Interesting

name: Essence
comment:
I know Victory was grateful y'all took such great care of her! 

Mandazi also looks delicious! I would love to try making it 😍

name: Gogo
comment: Wow!  What an exciting week!  Matemba I am so glad Shammah got to come visit with Janet.  It looks like y'all had a ton of fun!  I loved your poem!  Chiboda's birthday/safari swim party looked like so much fun.  I'm glad he got to spend time with his siblings.  Alexandra what a great birthday!  I know you had fun giving Janet her fantastic gift on your birthday.  She looks so happy.  Tim, you have talents I was not aware of : ).  I am so happy to hear about the Alinafe Kapsyepsye branch!  What a great thing for those women!  I know they will do well with Alinafe and Amayi's help.  Missing you guys!

name: Aunt Olivia
comment: You are all making so many memories with good people! Treasure it, because it will be gone before you know it. Sister, I'm so glad the world has people like you and the others at Alinafe and Good Samaritan to help make peoples lives better. Matemba, your vocab is impeccable!

name: Gram
comment: It seems like you have made some good friends in Malawi, Matemba. I’m happy that you got to go to Game Haven with Shammah. It was a week full of celebrations-2 birthdays and Father’s Day! Fun! I agree with Gogo. Your poem is beautiful. I miss you and I am looking forward to you coming home soon.

name: Gogo
comment: Wow, where to begin!  Such a great week!  Chiboda, I have to say I think your administrator got you right....I came, I saw, I conquered.  Especially after seeing the videos from sports day and the new school records you set!  Congratulations Chiboda, I'm so proud of you!  The game drives looked awesome.  Lions... Mtemba, your favorite!  And so many different animals at the watering hole (except the elusive Rhino, sorry Tim, but there's still time.)  What an experience.  I'm so happy for Amayi and her village.  Alexandra you have made such a positive impact in so many ways that will change their lives forever.  We are all so blessed that you found Good Samaritan those many years ago.  I am so glad GrandPa got to go, Alexandra and Tim are great at showcasing first rate tourism in Malawi!  Loved seeing new pictures of the babies, especially Bright looking at Tim.  So cute.  Only a month left!  :o

name: Gram
comment: Grampa had so much fun visiting all of you. His second favorite part was the snorkeling. He was amazed at how clear the water is. Thank you for showing him Malawi.
